name: Inner Sea Port Ruins
title: Inner Sea Port Ruins
summary: Empyrean ruins of an old Inner Sea port across Yaraq Cove (acpedia): an Empyrean stone tower where drudges live, Empyrean pillars leading into the Inner Sea, and a bunker over the Under Cove Crypt. In the kit: a 19.4 m stone tower hall (0x01001106) at the waterline, a colonnade of 12 ancient black columns (5.5 m) in two rows running 25 m east from it into the sea, the outer pair crowned with green flames, a Broken Seal of the Elder Spirits among them, fish and a water wisp, and 50 m south-east a low bunker ringed by four obelisks. The Festival Stone of Warmtide stands on the hill 100 m north-west.
